title.narrative: OEGI-Crops and Dairy Market Systems Development Activity

description.narrative: (Kenya): The Kenya Crops and Dairy Market Systems (KCDMS) activity will foster inclusive and sustainable agriculture-led growth by facilitating avenues for smallholder farmers, aggregators, processors, and other agricultural value chain actors to diversify into higher-value products and increase market access. KCDMS also promotes pathways to better nutrition through the production and consumption of nutrition-dense foods. Using FY 2021 funds, in alignment with the U.S. government priorities including climate change considerations, KCDMS will continue strengthening the capacity and commitment of county governments to invest in agriculture in order to enhance food security at the county and national levels. The activity will also enhance the voice of private sector and agribusiness associations to shape a favorable agribusiness enabling environment at county and national levels. The activity will co-create and implement food system interventions with lead firms that improve food security and market system resilience.With the KCDMS activity ending in September 2022, the activity has pivoted to ensure all interventions are Kenyan-owned and led. The activity will consolidate the gains made over the past three years through upgrading business management skills and improving agricultural product quality and quantity in order to meet end-market requirements. Focusing on strengthening market systems in the target value chains in partnership with the private sector, the activity is co-designing interventions that provide opportunities for youth and women-owned enterprises, a key objective under the Mission CDCS. KCDMS will continue assisting businesses for COVID-19 response and recovery. The activity will continue to promote trade opportunities along targeted value chains for regional and international markets. $2,000,000 of funding within this IM contributes to meeting the required "Micro, Small and Medium-sized earmark".. .
